title: Native-PAGE analysis of protein aggregation upon viral infection in mouse macrophages
protocol: Choose sex- and age-matched 8–12-week-old C57BL/6J mice.
Sterilize abdomen skin with 75 % alcohol.
Inject each mouse with 1 mL of starch broth intraperitoneally.
Euthanize the mice on day 3 by an appropriate method approved by the supervising institution.
Soak the mice in 75 % alcohol for 5 min.
Use sterile scissors and forceps to expose the peritoneum of the peritoneal cavity.
Inject 10 mL DMEM into the peritoneal cavity with a 20 mL syringe.
Gently massage the abdomen of the mice for 10–20 s.
Collect the peritoneal fluid containing peritoneal macrophages and transfer the cells to a sterile 50 mL centrifuge tube by a 20 mL syringe.
Centrifuge the peritoneal exudate cells at 500×g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellets with 3 mL RBC lysis buffer per mouse.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Add 3 mL PBS and mix gently.
Centrifuge at 500×g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatants.
Wash cells with PBS.
Centrifuge at 500×g for 5 minutes.
Discard PBS.
Resuspend the peritoneal macrophages in 10 mL DMEM cell culture medium.
Count the cells.
Adjust the concentration to 1 × 10^6 cells/mL in DMEM cell culture medium.
Seed 2 × 10^6 macrophages per well into 6-well plates containing 2 mL DMEM culture medium each well.
Incubate cells at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Discard cell culture medium after four hours.
Wash gently with PBS to remove non-adherent cells.
Add fresh DMEM culture medium.
Incubate cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 12–18 h.
Aspirate culture medium.
Add 2 mL fresh DMEM culture medium containing virus with a final concentration of 10 MOI.
Discard the medium from each well at the desired time post infection.
Wash each well with PBS buffer for 3 times.
Add 100 μL cold Lysis buffer per well and place the plate on ice.
Scrape and transfer cells to 1.5 mL pre-cold centrifuge tubes after 10 minutes.
Mix lysates gently and incubate on ice for 10–15 minutes.
Spin at 12000×g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatants to new 1.5 mL pre-cold centrifuge tubes.
Determine protein concentration using a BCA Protein Assay Kit.
Divide lysate into two tubes, each containing 50 μL cell lysate.
Add 10 μL 6×SDS loading buffer to tube 1 and boil for 5–10 minutes.
Add 10 μL 6×Native-PAGE loading buffer to tube 2.
Place tube 2 on ice.
Pre-run 7% Native Gels with Native-PAGE running buffer at 45 mA for 30 min on ice.
Add different running buffers to different parts of the electrophoresis tank.
Load tube 2 samples into gels.
Run the Native Gels on ice at 25 mA for 3 h.
Transfer proteins to a 0.45 μm PVDF membrane in 1× Western Transfer Buffer at 300 mA for 90 min or at 30 V overnight (approximate 700 min) on ice.
Disassemble the setup after blotting and place the membrane in 3% BSA for 60 min at 20°C–25°C or for 12 h at 4°C with gentle agitation.
Incubate the membrane with anti-TBK1 antibody (1:1000) at 4°C for 12 h.
Wash the membrane 3 times with 1× wash buffer at 80 rpm for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Incubate the membrane with a secondary antibody (1:5000) at 40 rpm for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C.
Discard the wash buffer.
Quantify the fluorescence of the secondary antibody using a SAGECREATION MiniChemi610 or GE Amersham Imager 600 RGB.
If the fluorescence of the protein is too weak, change the antibodies.
If the fluorescence of the protein is too strong, adjust the amount of proteins loading.
Run two or more gels to test the same samples.
Load tube 1 samples (step 20) into a 10% SDS-PAGE.
Load a pre-stained protein marker to estimate the size of the proteins.
Run the gel at 80 V in 1×SDS-PAGE running buffer for 1 hour, and then at 120 V for 1 hour.
Repeat steps 24–30 as necessary.
